verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents official SDKs built as one C++ core with six thin bindings. The Swift, Kotlin and React Native SDKs have concrete API docs covering streaming generation, chat, tool calling, structured output, STT/TTS, VAD, voice agents, VLM, image generation and model downloads, backed by a public runanywhere-sdks GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs (the community reports concern the rcli tool, not the SDKs), and documentation evidence for the remaining bindings beyond Swift, Kotlin and React Native.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
